We need to propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1.

We need to output JSON tree with type mol, children reaction nodes etc. Need to find appropriate templates: likely steps: 1) amide formation between carboxylic acid and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So precursor: acid (C=O) part: maybe trans-α,β-unsaturated acid attached to aromatic sulfonyl phenyl. The target has amide linking to aniline (anilide). So retrosynthesis: break amide to give acid (trans-α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Reaction type: amide coupling (carboxylic acid + amine). So step 1: target -> acid + aniline.

Step 2: The unsaturated acid could be formed via Doebner modification: from aromatic aldehyde (maybe p-tolyl? Actually the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl sulfonyl group). The acid part: /C=C/C(=O)N... The acid is α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid attached to phenyl sulfonyl group. So forward Doebner: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid (with decarboxylation). So break that to aldehyde + malonic acid. So step 2: unsaturated acid -> aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(... )cc2) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). The aldehyde is attached to sulfonyl phenyl? Actually the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl sulfonyl group via aromatic ring: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)...)cc2 attached to sulfonyl group. So the aldehyde precursor would be the same aromatic ring with aldehyde substituent (c2ccc(CHO)cc2). So step 2: break C=C and C=O formation.

Step 3: sulfonamide formation: target has NS(=O)(=O) attached to tolyl ring (Cc1ccc...). So break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonyl fluoride) and aniline (the tolyl amine). Actually the sulfonamide is between tolyl amine (p-toluidine) and sulfonyl group attached to phenyl ring (the same phenyl as aldehyde). So step 3: break sulfonamide to give p-toluidine (Cc1ccc(N)cc1) and sulfonyl chloride (ClS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(…)cc2). But we could also use sulfonyl chloride reacting with amine to give sulfonamide. So retrosynthesis: target -> p-toluidine + sulfonyl chloride.

Thus three steps: 1) amide coupling, 2) Doebner modification, 3) sulfonamide formation.

We need template IDs. We can search template catalog. Let's search for amide coupling template.
